_comment: Pinned third-party backup engines (CO-DEV-BKP-001 section 0 / ADR-01). Fill url + sha256 for
each engine from the vendor's OFFICIAL release page after the M0 benchmark picks versions.
scripts/fetch-engines.ps1 downloads each archive, refuses any SHA-256 mismatch, extracts the
exe and writes engines/dist/engines.manifest.json with the SHA-256 of the exe itself - the
worker re-verifies that hash before every launch and fails closed on mismatch (section 15).
Leave an engine's url empty to skip it (the agent only advertises backup.v1 if at least
kopia or restic is present; Google Drive repositories also need rclone).
kopia/rclone sha256 = the archive hash published in the vendor's checksums.txt / SHA256SUMS.
